Theme.name: Citizens as Co-Creators
Theme.summary: Work with residents to design a service, not only consult them after it is built.
Theme.objectives: Agree who is affected, how they take part, and what decision their input can change.

Theme.name: Anticipatory Government
Theme.summary: Use foresight to prepare a service before a known pressure arrives.
Theme.objectives: Name the signal the institution will watch and the decision it will rehearse.

Theme.name: Omnichannel Service Delivery
Theme.summary: Make a service coherent across offices, phone, and digital channels.
Theme.objectives: Pick one journey and remove a handoff that currently fails.

Theme.name: Personalized Public Services
Theme.summary: Adapt a service to a person’s situation without creating a new exclusion.
Theme.objectives: Define the data used, the safeguard, and the people who must not be disadvantaged.

Theme.name: Inclusive Emerging Technologies
Theme.summary: Try a new tool only where the institution can explain and govern it.
Theme.objectives: State the human decision that the tool will not replace.

Theme.name: Climate-Resilient Public Services
Theme.summary: Prepare a frontline service for heat, flood, or another local climate stress.
Theme.objectives: Connect the operational change to a specific risk the institution already recognizes.

Theme.name: Public–Private Innovation Partnerships
Theme.summary: Set terms for working with an external partner before a pilot begins.
Theme.objectives: Clarify ownership of learning, data, and the decision to stop.

Theme.name: Mindsets and Future Skills
Theme.summary: Build the team practices a new service needs.
Theme.objectives: Name the skill the team will practise during the six months, and how it will be supported.

Challenge.title: Residents cannot tell which channel will actually resolve a request
Challenge.problemStatement: People start in one channel and are asked to begin again in another. This demonstration statement is not a finding about a real service.
Challenge.context: A municipal office with a counter, a call centre, and a web form.
Challenge.affectedUsers: Residents with a straightforward case, and staff who re-enter the same information.
Challenge.evidence: Team observation only. No administrative dataset is attached.
Challenge.previousAttempts: A new form was added without changing the counter process.
Challenge.expectedBenefit: One journey with a visible status.

fieldSnapshot.label: Challenge and context
fieldSnapshot.helpText: What public problem is this work addressing, and in which institutional setting?

fieldSnapshot.label: Affected users and stakeholders
fieldSnapshot.helpText: Who is affected, who decides, and who will need to take part?

fieldSnapshot.label: Evidence and baseline
fieldSnapshot.helpText: What is known now? Separate evidence from assumptions.

fieldSnapshot.label: Previous attempts and lessons
fieldSnapshot.helpText: What has already been tried, and what should not be repeated?

fieldSnapshot.label: Root causes and constraints
fieldSnapshot.helpText: Which causes are within the team's influence, and which constraints are fixed?

fieldSnapshot.label: Proposed solution
fieldSnapshot.helpText: Describe the practical change, not only the aspiration.

fieldSnapshot.label: Alternative approaches considered
fieldSnapshot.helpText: Which other options were set aside, and why?

fieldSnapshot.label: Key assumptions and risks
fieldSnapshot.helpText: What must be true for this to work, and how would you know it is not?

fieldSnapshot.label: Expected outcomes
fieldSnapshot.helpText: What should be different for users or the institution if this succeeds?

fieldSnapshot.label: Proposed experiment or pilot
fieldSnapshot.helpText: What small test would produce useful evidence?

fieldSnapshot.label: Required permissions and institutional approvals
fieldSnapshot.helpText: Which formal authorization is required before any test begins?

fieldSnapshot.label: Resources, budget, and dependencies
fieldSnapshot.helpText: What people, budget, data, and partners does the test require?

fieldSnapshot.label: Success indicators
fieldSnapshot.helpText: How will the team recognize a useful result, including a result that says stop?

fieldSnapshot.label: Responsible persons
fieldSnapshot.helpText: Who is accountable for the next step? A named person is not an institutional approval.

fieldSnapshot.label: Next actions and deadlines
fieldSnapshot.helpText: List the next concrete actions and when they are due.

fieldSnapshot.label: Feedback and unresolved questions
fieldSnapshot.helpText: What is still contested or unknown?
